AccuracyDemand.description:
Consumed accuracy of one operation. Its product identity is declared by the math owner
and includes the actual output/action, derivative order/source and coordinate meaning.

allowance.description: Finite nonnegative error allowance; zero demands exact evidence.

class.description: Evidence class required by this operation, separate from original physical tolerances.

normalization.description: Coordinate/error normalization in which the allowance is stated.

product.description: Exact operation/product demanded; no capability table is inferred from this hash.

ActiveSetSnapshot.description: Native activity vectors in source order.

bounds.description: Native variable-bound statuses in source order.

constraints.description: Native constraint statuses in source order.

AdjointSettings.description:
Forward checkpoints of the adjoint backward pass (ADR-0110 item 3), a versioned boundary
document (ADR-0116 Outcome 6): the version is required, and absent fields take these
defaults. The backward pass replays at most `steps_between_checkpoints` native steps
from a stored checkpoint, and at most `max_checkpoints` are held at once, at least two
per scheduled segment; a forward pass that needs more stops with a typed memory limit.
Their estimated bytes are charged against the caller's memory allowance before any
native work.

max_checkpoints.description: Largest number of forward checkpoints held at once.

steps_between_checkpoints.description: Native forward steps between stored checkpoints (IDAS `IDAAdjInit`'s `Nd`).

AdmittedBindingBody.description: Immutable selected-revision binding; attribution is excluded from content identity.

revision.description: Exact revision that admitted member identity and role.

AdmittedBindingEntry.description: Canonical input with its expected physical contract and original attribution.

parameter.description: Whether the target is an authored parameter rather than a variable start/value.

supplied.description: Original input reference, retained only for attribution.

supplied_unit.description: Original unit, retained only for attribution.

inputs.description: Canonical plant parameter assignments in declared input order.

trajectories.description: Canonical controller trajectory values by declared binding index.

branch_start.description: Original branch permission and actual start policy.

exposure.description: Declared exposure/allocation design, including placement and interval meaning.

profiles.description: Equivalent permitted profile family; explicit settings remain constraints.

oneOf.description: Native execution only; excludes queue, preparation, assessment and publication.

value.description: Missing is unknown, never zero. Censored values cannot rank candidates.

records.description: Distinct scientific records selected by this application.

required.description: This claim was required, rather than a nonwinning union alternative.

targets.description: Exact admitted target identities; inheritance never widens this set.

case_id.description: The case declaration the requirement belongs to: the solved root when it is a case or a test, otherwise absent.

fit_id.description: The fit whose parameter requirement this is; absent otherwise.

instance_id.description: The instance whose preparation declared the requirement: the solved root instance (a fit experiment's own instance), or the implicit block whose trial hints declared it. Absent for a fit's parameter requirements and a generated rate system's.

model_id.description: The specialized definition the requirement belongs to: the root declaration of the model it is declared for. A modeling preparation's requirements name its root, an implicit block's trial hints their enclosing model's; a fit's parameter requirements name the one definition all its experiments specialize, and none when they specialize different ones.

BackendSettingsBody.description:
Typed backend settings of a request. Each variant is its adapter's pse-owned settings
type (`crate::settings`), present in every build, and identity derives from serde, never
from a hand-written field list (F09). The document form is tagged by the registry
`backend` spelling; the routed backend's native defaults have no document form, so a
document states them by omitting its settings. A backend this build does not link is
refused at admission, never at decoding.

oneOf.description: Ipopt linear solver with its parameters, barrier strategy and initial-point push.

bound_frac.description:
Minimum relative distance of a cold initial point from its bounds (`bound_frac`);
admission refuses more than one half, Ipopt's registered range.

bound_push.description: Minimum absolute distance of a cold initial point from its bounds (`bound_push`).

linear.description: Symmetric-indefinite factorization of the KKT systems.

restart.description: Restart of a submitted primal-dual seed: barrier and pushes (L-N3).

oneOf.title: IpoptSettings

oneOf.description: POUNCE method and complete native FERAL configuration.

restart.description: Interior-point restart of a submitted primal-dual seed (L-N3).

oneOf.title: PounceSettings

oneOf.description: KINSOL method controls; scales and the step tolerance derive from policy.

anderson.description: Native Anderson history for Picard/fixed point; zero disables acceleration.

anderson_delay.description: Iterations before Anderson acceleration starts (`KINSetDelayAA`); Anderson only.

damping.description: Picard/fixed-point damping in (0,1]; Newton and line search require one.

eta.description: Inexact-Newton forcing term; Krylov routes only.

linear.description: Native linear solver for equation/Picard profiles; fixed point requires the default.

max_newton_step.description:
Maximum scaled Newton step (`KINSetMaxNewtonStep`), at least one scaled unit
because KINSOL raises a smaller cap to one; Newton/line search only. `None` keeps KINSOL's
`1000 * ||D_u u_0||`.

orthogonalization.description: Anderson QR orthogonalization; Anderson acceleration only.

preconditioner.description:
Krylov preconditioner from the analytic Jacobian (`KINSetPreconditioner`);
KINSOL preconditions on the right.

setup_interval.description: Maximum nonlinear iterations between linear setups; fixed point requires the default.

oneOf.title: KinsolSettings

oneOf.description: HiGHS method, opt-in diagnostics and partial MIP start.

diagnostics.description:
Opt-in native work, separate from the original candidate except the
fixed-commitment LP, which prices it.

method.description: Eligible LP algorithm; mixed models retain native class routing.

nodes.description:
MIP node budget, separate from the iteration budget (F10). `None` leaves the native
default (no node limit), so the time limit alone bounds the search.

sparse_start.description: Partial source-attributed MIP start, with unspecified coordinates absent.

oneOf.title: HighsSettings

oneOf.description: The pse-owned Clarabel settings: mode and every admitted native control.

chordal_decomposition_complete_dual.description: Complete the dual of decomposed PSD cones.

chordal_decomposition_enable.description:
Chordal decomposition of PSD cones; `ReusableData` disables it. Without the SDP
profile only the chordal defaults are admitted.

direct.description: KKT direct solver; only MKL Pardiso admits more than one thread.

input_sparse_dropzeros.description: Drop explicit input zeros; `ReusableData` disables it.

min_switch_step_length.description: Minimum step length before switching to symmetric scaling.

oneOf.title: ClarabelSettings

oneOf.description: SCIP's nested Ipopt linear solver, seed and node budget.

exact.description:
Exact rational MILP (`SCIPenableExactSolving`); admitted for linear programs
without native forms, and never with reoptimization, IIS generation (SCIP's IIS
finders do not support exact solving) or concurrency.

iis.description:
After a proof of infeasibility, compute an irreducible infeasible subsystem of the
true exported program (`SCIPgenerateIIS`).

nlp_linear_solver.description:
Linear solver of the nested Ipopt (`nlpi/ipopt/linear_solver`): the image's one
Ipopt, so the same type the Ipopt adapter's settings select.

nodes.description:
Total branch-and-bound node budget including restarts (`limits/totalnodes`);
absent leaves the deadline as the only budget.

pool.description: Number of ranked stored solutions reported beside the candidate (0: none).

reoptimize.description:
Retain the native search tree across a finite MIP sequence whose constraint system
is unchanged and whose linear objective changes (`SCIPenableReoptimization`).

seed.description: Random seed shift (`randomization/randomseedshift`), recorded with the result.

oneOf.title: ScipSettings

oneOf.description: The POUNCE-convex interior-point method's choices and FERAL configuration.

crossover.description: Cross over from the interior-point solution to a vertex of a linear program.

equilibrate.description: Ruiz-equilibrate the data before the solve.

linear.description:
Native linear settings. A batch factors each instance serially: its parallelism is
across instances.

self_dual.description:
Solve through the homogeneous self-dual embedding, which detects primal and dual
infeasibility from the iterates, instead of the direct infeasible-start method.

oneOf.title: PounceConvexSettings

oneOf.description: First-order Uno filter trust-region SQP or SLP.

limited_memory.description: Positive L-BFGS history for SQP; exactly zero for SLP.

method.description: SQP uses an L-BFGS Hessian; SLP consumes no Hessian history.

trust_radius.description: Initial native trust radius, in normalized coordinates.

oneOf.title: UnoSettings

oneOf.description: Serial PETSc direct trust-region root profile.
oneOf.title: PetscSettings

Basis.description: Native basis values retain their original integer codes.

value.description: Physically typed value; bare numbers are not input values.

BindingQuantity.description: One finite quantity with complete declared physical meaning and a representation unit.

quantity.description: Complete quantity type, including basis, datum and subject.

BindingTarget.description: A submitted reference; paths are attribution after admission.

oneOf.description: Authored member path in the selected revision.
Stable instantiated member identity.

BlockSolveOverrideBody.description:
Native realization and finite work controls of one compiler-issued block.
Physical numerical meaning, intent, branch permission and authored start stay inherited.

backend.description: Explicit eligible backend; omission uses contextual Auto selection.

controls.description: Optional finite controls within the original aggregate allowance.

settings.description: Typed settings admitted against this actual block.

BoundaryDiagnosticBody.description: Stable structured cause shared by Rust and the public error projection.

applicability.description: Complete scientific evidence on demanded paths, including refused claims.

causes.description: Ordered retained cause envelopes, preserving repeated aggregate occurrences.

class.description: Machine-readable disposition; callers never parse the message.

code.description: Detailed semantic identity, authoritative over every coarse projection.

locations.description: Available source locations. Empty means unattributed, not a guessed source.

observations.description: Values observed while checking the contract.

rule.description: The violated named contract, not a replacement for source identities.

severity.description: Error, warning or information; a warning never makes a model invalid.

sources.description: All affected authored identities, in deterministic order.

stage.description: Operation boundary, such as selected admission or provider registration.

validity.description: The lineage of a rejected authored validity predicate; absent on every other finding.

BranchPolicy.description: Root-selection meaning retained by every proposal and correction.

connected.description: Required precisely for the connected policy.

kind.description: Any qualified root, or continuation on a declared connected sheet.

BuildObservation.description: The build/linkage fact for one registered adapter.

identity.description: The adapter's additional native build contract, when one exists.

linked.description: This binary links the native implementation.

Bytes.description:
Exact bytes, compared, framed and stored byte for byte. A package data document's
content is one; text is never implied.

CaseOperation.description: One authored solve operation under its admitted route and existing settings document.

route.description: Route captured from the declaration's admission.

CompositionRequestBody.description: Hard caller constraints retained by automatic and explicitly declared composition.

advice.description: Full frozen descriptive body; absent leaves the complete baseline policy.

limits.description: Additional finite counters; absent retains the admitted caller controls.

policy.description: Automatic resolution or explicit declaration binding.

recovery.description: Permitted later start origins. Empty grants no replacement origin.

ConnectedPath.description:
Explicit originating path/sheet and the consumed transport/orientation witnesses.
Supplying identities is not proof: the responsible path owner validates the products.

sheet.description: Selected root sheet; a shared regime label alone is insufficient.

transport.description: Transport evidence between the source and target bindings.

ContextCutBody.description: Exact project journal position; never a source revision sequence or wall clock.

ContextSelectionBody.description: Complete frozen selection. Deserializing this document grants no source authority.

effective_at_us.description: UTC instant in signed microseconds since the Unix epoch.

ControllerOperation.description: Serializable controller inputs; package/prepared analysis handles are reconstructed.

predictions.description: Existing advanced-step prediction mapping; absence means full solves.

CovarianceOrigin.description: Statistical provenance is independent of matrix admissibility.

oneOf.description: Resolve or reconcile actual qualified fit content and its local validity.

record.description: Absent only for a still-owned in-process fit; a decoded reference then refuses.

run_id.description: Scientific run identity, checked against the selected actual fit.

oneOf.description: Caller-declared covariance with uncertified statistical provenance.

assumptions.description: Explicit statistical assumptions of this external input.

label.description: Attribution label; it never identifies a certified fit.

Dependency.description: Dependencies whose meaning does not depend on seed availability.

oneOf.description: Release after terminal completion, including failure or cancellation.
Require the operation owner's aggregate scientific permission.

DiagnosticExecutionRequest.description: New numerical work. Descriptive ReviewContext is deliberately not an input constructor.

allowance.description: Finite clock starts before document admission and preparation.

origin.description: Original retained failure/attempt link, independent of new success.

physical_documents.description: Explicit original physical source documents, keyed by declared filename.

settings.description: Existing solve policy; no diagnostic accuracy override is introduced.

DiagnosticOriginBody.description: Optional link to retained original evidence; never authority to use a scientific result.

attempt_id.description: Original durable attempt, absent for ephemeral execution.

failure.description: Retained original failure or scientific refusal; never reevaluated.

operation.description: Original published diagnostic operation, when observation was enabled.

step.description: Original requested step, when one is selected.

DiagnosticReproducer.description: Portable new request, independent of original outcome and scientific permission.

allowance.description: Explicit finite allowance for all reconstruction/admission/execution.

input.description: Original text or exact selected frozen codec.

origin.description: Original attribution; absent when the original failed before a run existed.

original_diagnostic.description: Independently retained typed original failure, if actually supplied.

original_failure_text.description: Original descriptive failure text, never promoted to a typed predicate.

original_operation.description: Original operation, including failures before an original run handle existed.

predicate.description: Selected exact typed predicate; absence permits running but no reproduction claim.

required_environment.description: Explicit runtime premises; descriptors do not locate executable factories.

DiffsolSettings.description:
Typed Diffsol-only method controls, a versioned boundary document (ADR-0116 Outcome 6):
the version is required, and absent fields take these defaults.

linear.description: Newton linear solver of the implicit schemes.

EndpointRequirement.description: Explicit final-result obligation, independent of the requested output grid.

event.description: Allowed terminal guard identity, required only for declared-event completion.

EstimatorOperation.description: Serializable estimator inputs for the existing horizon owner.

Evaluator.description:
Explicit evaluator implementation. Scalar C++ compilation is opt-in for eligible
demanded arithmetic products; provider calls and ordered guards remain host-owned.

oneOf.description: Portable library instruction interpretation.

Fixed conservative Linux x86-64 C++ profile. The finite allowance covers
each module's export temporaries, named compiler outputs, loaded code,
template metadata and bounded diagnostic reader; worker numeric scratch
remains independently charged from the exported stack.

module_bytes.description: Prepaid complete native preparation/module capacity for each arithmetic block.

ExtensionQuantityValue.description: A row or nested value projected from the registry declaration.

FiniteBound.description: A finite real of either sign: a bound, a weight or a stated value.

FiniteDifferenceSettings.description: Typed finite-difference pattern, coloring and native reuse controls.

pattern.description: Declared Hessian support, falling back to conservative Jacobian/objective support.

reuse_tolerance.description: Relative native iterate distance permitting Hessian reuse.

FitCovarianceRecord.description: Exact canonical selection of the fit that owns the covariance.

attempt.description: Exact native attempt key; latest-result substitution is not allowed.

FitOperation.description: One authored fit selection; experiment data stays in the pinned source revision.

settings.description: Pending physical experiment controls, admitted against each actual experiment.

FitOptimizer.description: Fitting owns selection between its residual method and class-specific native NLPs.

oneOf.description: Use residual LM only when actual preparation establishes its complete eligibility.
Preserve the requested native NLP portfolio and settings.
Require the supported unconstrained residual interpretation before effects.

FitPreparationDocumentForPhysicalSimulat.description: Decoded fit preparation. Native fitting resolves its selected model and experiments.

experiment_workers.description: Finite independent experiment workers, separately from profile chains.

optimizer.description: Fitting-owned method selection, resolved before scientific effects.

simulations.description: Native dynamic settings by experiment identity.

solver.description: Canonical solve settings; their own owner admits cross-field rules.

FitUncertaintyBody.description:
What a fit derives from its estimate beyond the covariance, which every fit with free
parameters derives (ADR-0118 item 8; Plan 22 S3).

level.description: The confidence level of the intervals, below one.

predictions.description:
Also propagate the covariance to the included observations' predictions,
`Σ_y = R·Σ_θ·Rᵀ` over the fit's response derivatives (Plan 22 S4); their count
squared is bounded by the profile's `max_cells`.

profile.description:
Also derive profile-likelihood intervals under these controls; absent derives Wald
intervals alone.

Fraction.description: A finite fraction in (0, 1]: a damping factor, a step fraction or a relative push.

FrozenAdviceBody.description: Full immutable body retained with effective settings, including all excluded outcomes.

limits.description: Original allowances for applicability checking; advice never widens them.

support.description: Support established by the retained comparison.

HighsDiagnostics.description: Requested native diagnostic work, bounded by the original attempt's deadline.

basis_inverse.description:
Rows of the basis inverse `B⁻¹` at these basis positions, with the basic variables,
for an optimal continuous LP with a valid basis.

cut_pool.description: The MIP solver's cut pool after root cut generation (callback kind 7).

fixed_lp.description:
Duals of the MIP's LP with its discrete columns fixed at the solution
(`Highs_getFixedLp`), conditional on that commitment. When that LP reaches the MIP
candidate's objective they become the candidate's multipliers, and the candidate
states the commitment (ADR-0118 item 9).

iis.description: Native irreducible infeasible subsystem; MIP scope is its LP relaxation.

presolve.description:
Native presolve of a copied model: the presolved LP and, for a continuous LP, the
postsolved solution of that LP.

ranging.description: Basis sensitivity ranges for an optimal continuous LP with a valid basis.

rays.description: Native primal/dual rays when available for the continuous model.

relaxation.description:
Separate feasibility-relaxation solve on a copied LP/MIP. Negative penalties
forbid violation, as in the native API; no penalty is inferred from units.

HighsPenalties.description: Complete physical penalty declarations for native feasibility relaxation.

global.description: Global lower-bound, upper-bound and constraint penalties.

Complete frozen algebraic constructor and source; runtime factory checks remain live.

ReproductionPredicateBody.description: Exact typed failure predicate. No message parsing or broad exception matching.

conditions.description: Explicit necessary observed conditions. Exact values; no implicit tolerance.

sources.description: Exact selected original source population, including explicit absence.

validity.description: Exact recorded validity lineage, when present.

ResearchDatasetBody.description: A row or nested value projected from the registry declaration.

ResearchPublicationBody.description: A row or nested value projected from the registry declaration.

ResearchSelectionBody.description: A row or nested value projected from the registry declaration.

ResearchSource.description: Authenticated original research ancestry carried by actual operation inputs.

publication.description: Explicit parameter publication ancestry, when consuming its new source.

RestartBarrier.description: The initial barrier parameter of an interior-point restart.

oneOf.description:
The final barrier value the producing interior-point solve recorded with the seed. A
seed without one (an authored seed) leaves the native default in force, and the
receipt says so.
A stated positive value.

ReviewOutputSelection.description: Original output owner/field/partition and finite-value or trajectory-time predicate.

maximum_bits.description: Optional finite upper bound represented by IEEE bits.

minimum_bits.description: Optional finite lower bound represented by IEEE bits.

ReviewScientificSelection.description: A request to the scientific owner, not a caller assertion of lineage or permission.

output.description: Existing selected-output semantics; absence selects the original relation range.

Runtime.description: Process state that linear-solver admission depends on, observed on the calling thread.

cancellation.description: OpenMP cancellation (`OMP_CANCELLATION`), fixed when the OpenMP runtime started.

linked.description:
Linear solvers the linked Ipopt was built with (`IpoptGetAvailableLinearSolvers`);
the runtime library loader is excluded.

parameter.description: Position of the input in the contract's parameter order.

times.description:
Strictly increasing change times after the start and up to the end; a change at
the end is observed by the final sample only.

ScientificCoordinateValue.description: A row or nested value projected from the registry declaration.

SeedOrigin.description: Portable provenance of an output seed, distinct from its coordinate compatibility.

run.description: Public run identity when one exists.

SelectedStudyVariant.description: One selected Cartesian ordinal and its explicit scientific intent.

ordinal.description: Last-choice-fast mixed-radix ordinal, independent of visible occurrence order.

point.description: Operation, physically typed assignments, dependencies and original start policy.

SemanticProductKey.description:
Actual consumed dependencies of a semantic product. Omitted fields were not consumed;
producer ownership determines compatibility, including lawful transport between values.

branch.description: Actual selected sheet/branch evidence, when consumed.

point.description: Point actually consumed, distinct from a future proposal's target.

SensitivityRequest.description:
Physical parameter sensitivities at a regular square Root or an optimization's local
solution (ADR-0144; ADR-0118). Roots use qualified equality Jacobian response;
optimization uses KKT-point analysis. Results use original physical coordinates and
units, with certified validity or the condition that withheld them.

parameters.description:
Declared parameters of the solved case by identity, in the order results report
them; at least one, none repeated.

propagation.description:
Also propagate a fit's parameter covariance through the sensitivities to named
variables (Plan 22 S4); absent propagates none and is not encoded.

reduced_hessian.description:
Also compute the reduced Hessian over the parameters: the second derivative of the
optimal value.

SimulationOperation.description: One authored integrated simulation and its pending physical controls.

settings.description: Pending physical integration controls; absence requests authored controls.

Snapshot.description: One immutable build/runtime observation supplied by the composition boundary.

adapters.description: Registered adapter observations, including absent native implementations.

ipopt.description: Actual process/thread state consumed by Ipopt linear-solver admission.

scip_omp_cancellation.description: The declared OpenMP cancellation setting consumed by SCIP's nested Ipopt.

SolveControls.description:
Finite shared attempt controls chosen by the caller; solver-specific settings remain
native typed values. Accuracy is not among them: it is resolved from the numerical
policy ([`ResolvedAccuracy`]). A document states the time limit in seconds; absent
fields take these defaults and unknown fields are refused.

foreign_bytes.description:
Positive foreign-library allowance of this solve, in bytes: its reservation charges
it, and a library that enforces its own memory limit receives it. Absent, the
deployment's allowance applies (`MathPolicy.foreign_bytes`); an absent allowance is
not encoded, so controls without one keep their identity.

hessian.description: Hessian representation for compatible NLP methods.

history.description: Bounded retained progress and failure events.

options.description: Additional native options, admitted by the selected adapter.

start.description: Numerical start policy, independent of native allocation reuse.

time_limit.description: Positive wall-clock allowance, including callbacks, in seconds.

SolveSettings.description:
The settings of one solve. The version is required; every other field takes the
default of [`SolverProfile::default`] when absent.

backend.description: An explicitly selected eligible backend; absent is deterministic routing.

propertyNames.description: Stable identity of semantic block membership within an admitted scope.

block_workers.description: Maximum independent ready blocks; actual capacity is admitted by the existing owner.

composition.description: Requested composition; omission chooses automatic resolution without replacement starts.

convexity_absolute.description:
Absolute eigenvalue budget of a numerical convexity assessment; with the relative
budget, it permits numerical assessment, and absent both, only exact certification.

convexity_relative.description: Relative eigenvalue budget of a numerical convexity assessment.

numerics.description: ID-keyed numerical requirements and acceptance budgets.

presolve_options.description: Native presolve options; an explicit policy only.

reconstruction.description: Explicit reconstruction evidence class and finite refinement allowances.

required_passes.description: Passes that may not silently become unavailable; an explicit policy only.

settings.description: Typed settings of one backend; absent is the routed backend's native defaults.

SourceChoice.description: A finite structural dimension. Alternatives are edits against the one admitted base.

alternatives.description: Ordered alternatives; ordering is part of ordinal reconstruction.

SourceDeltaBody.description:
An atomic source edit against one exact locally admitted receiver. Omission retains
inherited objects; deletion must be named explicitly.

additions.description: New declarations, appended in this order after retained parent rows.

documents.description: Explicit document ownership changes, including their data payloads.

fits.description: Explicit fit ownership changes; omitted fits remain inherited.

parent.description: Exact revision_id of the receiver; actual publication separately checks its canonical origin.

replacements.description: Existing declarations replaced in their original ordered positions.

SourceDocumentDelta.description: Parent-qualified document additions, replacements and removals.

removals.description: Documents whose ownership and optional data payload are explicitly removed.

replacements.description: Complete replacement of an existing document and its optional data bytes.
Existing fitting declarations replaced in full.

SourceLocationBody.description: Authored location attached by the owner that has the source map.

document.description: Actual parser document identity; absence cannot qualify byte offsets.

occurrence_position.description: Original position within that occurrence role.

occurrence_role.description: Compiler-supplied occurrence role, independent of a display name.

path.description: Definition or document path, never a backend-local node identifier.

revision.description: Immutable source interpretation context; absence is explicitly unattributed.

source.description: Original semantic occurrence or instance identity.

start.description: UTF-8 starting byte offset, when supplied by the parser/compiler.

SourcedRequirement.description: Selection supplies precedence; declarations cannot promote themselves to analysis overrides.

StartPolicy.description: Declared start intent, separate from the chosen actual start.

oneOf.description: Operation-owned fresh start.
Continue from one admitted predecessor role.

role.description: Output role admitted by the operation owner.

oneOf.description: Explicit supplied seed: incompatibility never falls back.

role.description: Role required from the supplied seed facts.

seed.description: Immutable supplied artifact identity; facts cannot substitute another seed.

StartRules.description: Entry intent and separately declared permissions for later starts in this task.

policy.description: Existing request's entry policy; a strategy cannot reinterpret its precedence.

recovery.description:
Permitted replacement origins. A fresh task-produced proposal may precede
a non-explicit entry; inherited products still obey the entry policy.

assembly.description: Per-case sparse assembly and complete numerical-worker admission limits.

class_proof_work.description: Conservative shared domain/class construction work, not measured operations.

StudyDefinition.description:
Version 14 of a study's definition: the store's `definition` document and the content of
the study's request identity.

context.description: Exact historical source context selected before admission, never a latest query.

modeling_revision.description: The exact immutable canonical modeling revision.

physical.description: The source bundle of the physical package.

points.description: The explicit admitted points, in index order.

research.description: Frozen research ancestry consumed by original study admission.

variants.description: Lazy science retained once; when present explicit admitted points are empty.

StudyDetailDemand.description:
Exact named relations with a finite per-occurrence materialization allowance.
Exceeding the allowance refuses detail capture; it never silently truncates rows.

maximum_bytes.description: Maximum retained physical detail bytes across these relations.

maximum_rows.description: Maximum total rows across these relations, including failed detail.

members.description: Exact scientific members. Selected rows retain every original column.

relations.description: Registry-owned result relations; an empty list requests no detail.

StudyMemberDemand.description:
Registry-typed scientific keys within an occurrence. Run identity is supplied
by the original occurrence rather than accepted from a detail selector.

oneOf.description: One algebraic variable at its original absolute solve step.
One algebraic constraint at its original absolute solve step.
One fitted parameter.
One observation in its original experiment.

observation_id.description: Authored observation identity within that experiment.

oneOf.description: The original samples of one trajectory symbol.

StudyOperation.description: Immutable request recorded by a study occurrence and replayed by either executor.

admitted_horizon.description: Canonical physical assignments; required for every horizon descriptor.

output.description: Explicit occurrence detail retained independently of original completion.

preparation.description: Complete preparation controls using existing owners' remote projections.

StudyOutputDemand.description: Detail selected independently of the original completion and assessment.

oneOf.description: Retain the complete original occurrence report and its public relations.
Retain mandatory summaries and only the explicitly bounded selected detail.

detail.description: Selected detail for usable occurrences, including requested KPI relations.

failed_detail.description: Independently bounded detail for failed, flagged or cancelled occurrences.

StudyPoint.description: One point of a study to start.

operation.description: Supported existing operation and its complete inputs.

overlay.description: Submitted physical assignments, admitted once before any point is scheduled.

policy.description: Occurrence identity and explicit dependency/start policy.

preparation.description: Existing preparation controls, serialized without a second default authority.

StudyPointDefinitionBody.description: One point of a study's definition.

binding.description: Canonical physically admitted member assignments; original paths are attribution.

binding_hash.description: The hash of the point's value bindings.

operation.description: Reconstructable admitted descriptor of one existing operation.

StudyPointPolicy.description: Authored policy choices; seed consumption is supplied only by operation admission.

StudyVariants.description: Immutable finite structural alternatives, without Cartesian materialization.

choices.description: Independent structural dimensions, applied in declared order.

selected.description: Explicit selected ordinals in original visible occurrence order.

source.description: Complete admitted base source and physical identity.

TargetSpec.description: Exact admitted coordinate; declared representation is retained through normalization.

declared_tolerance.description: Explicit physical acceptance budget already owned by a balance/output declaration.

id.description: Source identity, NIL only for the single objective.

integer.description: Coordinate substitution must preserve the integer lattice.

kind.description: Variable, row, objective, observable or closure.

unit.description: Representation of values crossing the original oracle.

TermPolicy.description: Bounded examination of original signed additive terms, before simplification.

cancellation.description: Normalized subset sum at or below which the subset is reported as cancelling.

findings.description: Maximum number of cancelling subsets reported.

maximum_terms.description: Largest subset size examined for cancellation, from 2 to 32.

mismatch.description: Ratio to the largest magnitude beyond which a smaller term is reported as mismatched.

zero.description: Magnitude at or below which a term is treated as zero and not examined.

Tolerance.description: A finite, strictly positive tolerance, budget or push.

TrustRegion.description: Normalized radius bounds consumed by the native trust-region method.

minimum.description: Positive lower radius; reaching it stops the native trajectory.

ValidityLineage.description:
What a rejected authored validity predicate guards (ADR-0123 Outcome 4, Plan 23 H5): its
layer and the declaration stating it; for the form and data layers the form it belongs
to, the parameter sets whose values bound it and the form's declared arguments it
constrains; for the closure layer the model members its range bounds. A fixture's
expected validity failure is matched against this lineage, not against a rule text.

form.description:
The form: the function declaration whose evaluation was rejected; absent on the
closure layer.

layer.description:
The form layer (a function's own domain), the data layer (a declared envelope) or
the closure layer (an annotated range).

members.description: The model members a closure range bounds; empty on the form and data layers.

sets.description: The table rows or entities whose values bound the predicate, in order.

source.description:
The form itself, the relation or kind declaration declaring the envelope, or the
closure range's annotation.

variables.description: Positions of the constrained arguments among the form's declared arguments.

VersionRequirement.description: A row or nested value projected from the registry declaration.

WarmPayloadSnapshot.description: Portable seed data with explicit numerical observations.

oneOf.description: Root-system source coordinates.

primal.description: Source-coordinate primal values, including explicit special floats.

oneOf.description: NLP source coordinates and optional restart state.

barrier.description: Barrier parameter when supplied by the native owner.

bound_duals.description: Lower and upper bound duals in source order.

working_set.description: Active-set state and its coordinate transformation.

oneOf.description: LP/QP source coordinates and native simplex status codes.

dual.description: Optional column and constraint dual starts.

WarmRestart.description:
How an interior-point method re-centres a complete primal-dual seed (L-N3). With the
cold-start defaults a seeded restart is pushed back towards the analytic centre and loses
most of its benefit, so a restart states its barrier and its pushes. Absent fields take
these defaults across the Python boundary (ADR-0113).

barrier.description: Initial barrier parameter of the restart (`mu_init`).

bound_frac.description:
Relative push of the primal seed from its bounds (`warm_start_bound_frac`); at most
one half.

bound_push.description: Absolute push of the primal seed from its bounds (`warm_start_bound_push`).

mult_bound_push.description: Push of the bound multipliers from zero (`warm_start_mult_bound_push`).

slack_bound_frac.description:
Relative push of the slack seed from its bounds (`warm_start_slack_bound_frac`); at
most one half.

slack_bound_push.description: Absolute push of the slack seed from its bounds (`warm_start_slack_bound_push`).

WarmStartSnapshotBody.description:
Typed semantic seed snapshot. Nonfinite numbers have explicit observations; zero's
sign survives in real observations. Snapshot attribution is separate from content identity.

origin.description: Producing occurrence, when there is one.

WorkLimits.description:
Additional finite work allowances. None imposes no additional counter cap under the
enclosing finite ExecutionScope; it never denotes an observed zero or a new deadline.
Every supplied counter is finite; Some(0) expressly prohibits that operation.

attempts.description: Maximum executions, including the first attempt. A task requires at least one.

evaluations.description: Evaluations admitted by the charging owner, including rejected trials.

factorizations.description: Numerical factor constructions, distinct from structural analysis/setup reuse.

iterations.description: Native/library iterations, where the operation exposes them.

proof_steps.description: Verification/proof operations accounted by their owning verifier.

WorkingSetSnapshot.description: Typed active set with the transformation under which its indices are meaningful.

active.description: Native activities when compiled with active-set support.

description: Read-only owner-composed closure explanation; no protection grant escapes in this document.

known_source_bytes.description: Byte estimate for known source/evidence files; result encoding size is unknown before export.

manifest.description: Exact current source and metadata closure.

result_bytes_known.description: Result sizes are observations made only while copying the selected rows.
